name: 09_seedhead
prompt: A single circular sunflower seed head (the central disc only, no petals) seen perfectly straight-on, filling the frame as a perfect circle on a fully transparent background. Painted in extremely thick Van Gogh-style impasto: hundreds of crusty dabs of dark umber, olive green, burnt sienna and ochre paint arranged in interlocking golden-angle Fibonacci spirals, slightly domed, a greenish-ochre centre, a ring of tiny yellow florets around the rim. Soft raking light reveals the rough bristling relief. No petals, no stem, no text.
